title: New Orleans as a piano town: solo work in the joints
summary: Before pianos were used in bands, pianists played alone in the joints as entertainment.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah. You see? Long years ago, they didn't use piano in bands. You know, piano played by itself. Entertainment by itself, spring and play.
Yeah. Yeah. And where did these piano players found work? Work in... Found work.
In joints. Yeah. To use the piano. Piano. Piano balls.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. A lot of good piano players. Do you remember any others? Mostly. I got some other names. Well, if you call some of them, I might know them.
